note: Public-safe, SYNTHETIC SAM (transport-adapter) execution observation for one governed MCP tool invocation that was admitted by policy but never received a transport response (session timed out before any response frame arrived). This is NOT a live transport capture. Because no bytes were ever observed, error_observation_digest is explicit null rather than a fabricated digest, and returned_payload_digest is explicit 'unavailable'. A transport failure is a valid, non-success receipt; the prior admission decision (decision_ref) is not treated as evidence the call executed.
